name: feature-poll
blurb: Interactive poll collecting single or multi-vote feature requests with live result tallies.
description: Compound component system (Root, Header, Title, Description, Options, Option, Indicator, Label, Footer) supporting single or multiple-choice voting. Shows vote counts and percentages, tracks selection state, keyboard-accessible option navigation.
use_when: Feature voting or priority surveys where users pick options and results update live.
avoid_when: Very large option counts (layout not designed for dense lists) or when results must be hidden until submission.
a11y: Options are buttons with full keyboard navigation (arrow keys, enter). Supports both controlled (value prop) and uncontrolled (defaultValue) selection. Focus management and ARIA attributes via context.
